title: 23-BCV-017 — Unvented roof assembly

facts.text: The variance applies to roof assemblies in Part 9 residential buildings and refers to Sentences 9.19.1.1.(1) and 9.19.1.4.(1).
The permit application is to include the design requirements from the named 32139.000 Alberta Unvented Roofs Evaluation Report.

The cited report covers three assembly strategies and identifies design conditions including thermal resistance, air/vapour control, winter interior relative humidity, spray-foam installation standards and roof-water management.
